fields.summary_ko.0: CoreWeave (CRWV) Q3 revenue grew to $3.66B (+168%), but Jefferies cut its target price from $150 to $90, advising that comparable demand is accessible through Amazon.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS Q3 revenue $46.0B (+39%), operating profit $17.8B, while CoreWeave added $2.3B in revenue over one year at 1/5 AWS level; hyperscalers account for 42% of credible data center pipeline.
fields.summary_ko.2: CoreWeave's interest expense surged from $310M to $846M over one year, representing 23% of quarterly revenue, exposing the limitations of a high-debt middleman business model.
